messages:
alex-support: Customer reported rerank API returning 400 with body-level parse error after traffic passes through their edge proxy. They included raw request and response from their side.

alex-support: Their curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"items":[{"id":"1","text":"a"}],"topK":1}'
```

alex-support: Our gateway logs show request body arriving as `{"svc_meta":{...},"svc_payload":{"items":[{"id":"1","text":"a"}],"topK":1}}` so server sees no top-level `items` -> 400 `missing required field: items`.

maria-eng: Do we have a proxy that mutates JSON keys? That wrapper looks like an envelope. Any special headers?

alex-support: Customer uses internal proxy with header `X-Envelope: true`. They said it was added by their load-balancer for tracing.

ben-platform: We shipped an edge proxy change in 2.4.1 that auto-envelopes payloads when `X-Envelope` is truthy. It wraps incoming body into `svc_payload` and moves metadata to `svc_meta` for downstream services. This breaks endpoints that expect raw shapes.

sam-qa: Repro steps on local:
```
# without envelope
curl -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"items":[{"id":"1","text":"a"}],"topK":1}' http://localhost:8080/v1/rerank -v
# returns 200
# with envelope header
curl -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Envelope: 1' -d '{"items":[{"id":"1","text":"a"}],"topK":1}' http://localhost:8080/v1/rerank -v
# body received by service: {"svc_payload":{"items":...}} -> 400 missing items
```

maria-eng: Confirmed. Server error message is cryptic for customers. Suggest improving validation error to include received top-level keys, e.g., "expected 'items' but found ['svc_meta','svc_payload']".

carol-sre: Short-term mitigation: update rerank handler to support both shapes (raw.items OR svc_payload.items) for a 1-week transition window. Long-term: fix proxy config to not envelope traffic for api.redwood.ai host.

ben-platform: I'll push a proxy config patch to disable envelope for /v1/rerank and deploy a canary. Also start a runbook to detect envelope-wrapped bodies and emit a distinct log tag `wrapped_by_proxy` so we can alert customers immediately.

alex-support: Suggested message to customer: "Workaround: add header X-Bypass-Envelope: 1 or ask your infra team to disable envelope for our host. We'll deploy a tolerant handler and a canary fix on our side as well"

maria-eng: Added a quick server-side tolerant patch (accept svc_payload.items) behind a feature flag, will enable canary on 3 hosts.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout of tolerant handler to support/svc-rerank:3 hosts at 2024-06-01T12:34:00Z.

alex-support: Customer confirmed header workaround works for them. Will follow up to schedule a clean fix. :thumbsup:

sam-qa: Followups: (1) add clearer 400 text; (2) add telemetry to catch proxy-wrapped requests; (3) update support KB with proxy envelope troubleshooting steps and curl examples.

carol-sre: Filing a postmortem template entry and ownership: ben-platform for proxy config, maria-eng for handler change, support to notify affected customers.

alex-support: Thanks team — marking this as escalated->in-progress and posting KB draft in #support-docs.
